params.name: deposit_ids
params.description: Filter by one or more deposit IDs

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Filter by one or more account IDs

params.name: transaction_hashes
params.description: Filter by one or more transaction hashes

params.name: assets
params.description: Filter by one or more asset codes (e.g. BTC, ETH)

params.name: states
params.description: Filter by one or more deposit states

params.name: state_reasons
params.description: Filter by one or more state reasons (e.g. `required_travel_rule_info`). Use with `states=PENDING_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW` to list deposits held for Travel Rule review.

params.name: travel_rule_status
params.description: Convenience filter for Travel Rule status. `pending` returns all deposits currently held awaiting Travel Rule verification (equivalent to `states=PENDING_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW&state_reasons=required_travel_rule_info`).

params.name: from_timestamp
params.description: Filter deposits from this timestamp (inclusive)

params.name: to_timestamp
params.description: Filter deposits up to this timestamp (inclusive)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-999)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of blockchain deposits. Filter by deposit IDs, account IDs, transaction hashes, assets, states, and timestamps.

params.name: deposit_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the deposit

items.docs: Retrieves a single blockchain deposit by its unique deposit ID.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: The participant whose deposit addresses should be returned. Must either match the calling platform or be a customer of the calling platform.

params.name: asset
params.description: Filter by asset. When omitted, addresses for all assets the participant holds are returned.

params.name: inactivity_interval
params.description: Only return addresses that have been inactive for at least this many days (1–1825).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of addresses to return (1–100). Defaults to `1`.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of addresses associated with your platform.
Creates a deposit address for a given asset.
Assigns a new owner to a digital wallet address.

info.name: Create a BOLT11 invoice for deposit

items.docs: Creates a Lightning Network invoice (BOLT11) to deposit funds to the informed participant account.

info.name: Create a test payment for a BOLT11 deposit invoice

items.docs: Simulate a payment of BOLT11 invoice deposit generated by /deposits/bolt11. (CERT only)
Funds a specified fiat account in the zerohash CERT environment. This is helpful when automating end-to-end testing or manually validating a feature. Not available in production.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (starts at 1).

params.name: asset
params.description: Filter by asset code (e.g., BTC, USD, ETH)

params.name: include_customer_deposits
params.description: Include deposits made by customers of your platform. Defaults to `true`. Ignored when `participant_code` is provided — a participant-scoped request always excludes customer deposits.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: Filter by a specific participant code. Always 6 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

params.name: account_label
params.description: Filter by account label (e.g., `general`, `sub_account_test`). Account labels are used to categorize accounts under a participant. Each participant `account_label` maintains a separate balance and transaction history.

params.name: settle_timestamp[gt]
params.description: Filter for deposits whose settlement timestamp (Unix milliseconds) is strictly greater than the value.

params.name: settle_timestamp[gte]
params.description: Filter for deposits whose settlement timestamp (Unix milliseconds) is greater than or equal to the value.

params.name: settle_timestamp[lt]
params.description: Filter for deposits whose settlement timestamp (Unix milliseconds) is strictly less than the value.

params.name: settle_timestamp[lte]
params.description: Filter for deposits whose settlement timestamp (Unix milliseconds) is less than or equal to the value.

params.name: settle_timestamp[e]
params.description: Filter for deposits whose settlement timestamp (Unix milliseconds) equals the value exactly.

params.name: parent_link_id_source
params.description: Filter deposits by the source system that originated the parent link (e.g. `rest_api`, `sdk`).

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of deposits made by you and your customers. Results are limited to the last 2 months.
Retrieves a list of all fiat accounts. You must include your participant_code in the reference field with any deposit to ensure that funds can be allocated correctly to your participant.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: Filters for all addresses associated with a participant_code

params.name: page_size
params.description: Limits the number of addresses returned in the response

params.name: offset
params.description: Skips over the specified number of addresses in the response
